clue.text: Corporation was hurt to have property threatening to collapse

parts.note: corporation is old jocular slang for a pot belly, a tum
someone wounded bled
to own something is to have it as property

explanation.surface: A council body was harmed by owning a building that is falling apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Corporation' reads as a company or council, but here it is the old humorous word for a large belly, TUM.
explanation.definitionFit: A ramshackle building in poor repair is said to be on the verge of falling down.

clue.text: Objectionable person delayed payment

definitions.meaning: a contemptible person, likened to the bloodsucking parasite
buying on credit, paying later, is buying on this

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are everyday British usage: a nasty little person, and credit as in buying something on account.

clue.text: Cleaning up, gloomy about small amount of cash

indicators.note: the word for gloomy goes around the coin, so it sits about it

parts.note: moping means sulking, being gloomy
P stands for a penny, a small British coin

explanation.surface: Someone sweeping up feels miserable over how little money they have.
explanation.definitionFit: Wiping a floor with a wet swab is a way of tidying or cleaning up spills.

clue.text: Certain animal has strayed, possibly Maria from Argentina

indicators.note: an animal that has strayed has wandered off course, so these letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Some creature has wandered off, perhaps belonging to an Argentinian woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has strayed' rearranges CERTAIN ANIMAL; the definition is by example, a woman called Maria from Argentina being one person from that region.
explanation.definitionFit: Argentina is in South America, so a woman from there is a native of that Spanish-speaking region.

clue.text: Scandinavian is taken in hand for training

indicators.note: the little word is placed inside the other letters, taken in by them
something put through training is reshaped, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Nordic person is being coached by someone experienced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hand' reads as a farmhand or helper being coached, but its four letters are only raw material for the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Denmark is one of the Scandinavian peoples.

clue.text: Bond suspicious about bombast

indicators.note: the word for suspicious goes around the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: wary means cautious, suspicious
a rant is bombastic, ranting speech

explanation.surface: A secret agent mistrusts all the hot air around him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' suggests the spy, but it is a guarantee or pledge.
explanation.definitionFit: A guarantee given by a maker is a binding promise, a kind of bond or pledge.

clue.text: Area of land in Western Brazil

definitions.meaning: a unit of land measurement, 4,840 square yards
a state in the far west of Brazil bordering Peru and Bolivia

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an imperial unit of land measure and the name of a remote Brazilian state.

clue.text: Wind fabric satisfactorily

parts.note: chino is a cotton twill cloth used for trousers
OK means all right, satisfactorily

explanation.surface: Twist the cloth so that it comes out well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wind' reads as a verb to go with fabric; it is the noun, a warm dry wind down the eastern Rockies.
explanation.definitionFit: This warm, dry wind blowing down the eastern slopes of the Rocky Mountains is a named regional wind.

clue.text: Tree — it's seen falling over, by me?

indicators.note: things falling over tumble into disorder, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: the yew is an evergreen tree

explanation.surface: A tree has been seen toppling, and I watched it happen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'falling over' mixes YEW with ITSSEEN. The definition is cryptic: something witnessed by me makes me the person who saw it.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who personally sees an event happen, so it was seen by them, is a witness to it.

clue.text: Turner excels with colour

parts.note: to cap something is to outdo or excel it
tan is a yellowish-brown colour

explanation.surface: The painter Turner is at his best with his use of colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' suggests the painter J M W Turner; it is something that turns, a rotating drum for winding cable on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship's vertical revolving drum for hauling in rope is something that turns, hence a turner.

clue.text: Salesman gets more money for repeat performance

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
a rise is a pay increase

explanation.surface: A sales representative earns a pay increase for doing the same job again.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical or theatrical repetition of an earlier passage or show is a restaging or encore.

clue.text: Gilbert's object all sublime Check tod Put in rime and only rime

annotationWithheld.why: Held as 'Gilbert's object all sublime Check tod Put in rime and only rime': 'Check tod' is OCR garble that the blank scan cannot resolve; the wordplay POETIC (put in rime) + JUST (only) + ICE (rime) needs no such words.
annotationWithheld.clue: Gilbert's object all sublime Check tod Put in rime and only rime

clue.text: For the greater part Elsa, for one, lacks the energy to run

indicators.note: the creature is without the letter for energy, it lacks it

parts.note: Elsa was the lioness in Born Free
E is the physics symbol for energy
to hare is to run fast

explanation.surface: Most of the time Elsa has no strength left for running.
explanation.walkthrough: Elsa is the famous lioness raised by Joy Adamson in Born Free; LIONESS without E gives LIONSS.
explanation.definitionFit: The biggest portion of anything, as a lion takes the most of a kill, is the larger part.

clue.text: Charming part of Japanese dress

definitions.meaning: a West Indian form of sorcery or a charm, so it is a means of charming
the broad sash worn with a kimono

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a kimono sash and also a variant of obeah, Caribbean witchcraft using charms.

clue.text: Gorge with popular chap from East minute. Africa

annotationWithheld.why: Held as 'Gorge with popular chap from East minute. Africa': 'minute.' is OCR garble splitting 'East Africa', and the blank scan cannot confirm the printed clue; ABYSS + IN + IAN would parse without it.
annotationWithheld.clue: Gorge with popular chap from East minute. Africa

clue.text: Marrying large and little woman?

parts.note: big means large
Amy is one of the March sisters in Little Women

explanation.surface: Someone weds a big woman and a small one at the same time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little woman' is Amy March from Louisa May Alcott's Little Women.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking a second spouse while still wed to the first is an illegal form of matrimony.

clue.text: Badly affected, swindle out of some money? Just the opposite

indicators.note: one piece is taken out of the other, giving a placement of one beside or within the other
reverses the relation, so the money is not inside the swindle but the swindle inside the money

parts.note: the sen is a small coin of Japan and other Asian countries
a trick is a con or swindle

explanation.surface: Someone hard hit has been cheated of a sum of cash.
explanation.walkthrough: The sen is a hundredth of a yen. 'Just the opposite' tells you to swap the roles 'out of' would give, so the swindle sits inside the money.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone struck down by illness or grief is severely afflicted, badly affected.

clue.text: Specific cape on island

parts.note: C is the map abbreviation for cape
taken as written
Crete is a Greek island

explanation.surface: A particular headland sits on a Mediterranean island.
explanation.definitionFit: Concrete as an adjective means definite or particular rather than abstract.

clue.text: Bigger lake

definitions.meaning: higher in rank or greater in size or quality
the largest of North America's Great Lakes

explanation.definitionFit: The word means greater or higher and also names the largest of the Great Lakes.

clue.text: Father holds one of the highest cards — that'll solve everything

indicators.note: the word for father goes around the other piece, holding it

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father
an ace is one of the top cards in a pack, so this is 'an ace'

explanation.surface: Dad is holding an ace, which will fix everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A cure-all remedy is supposed to solve every problem at once.

clue.text: Exiles from France I returned — c'est différent

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the French pronoun is read backwards

parts.note: je is French for I

indicators.note: French for different, so these letters appear in a different order

explanation.surface: A Frenchman back home finds things have changed and throws people out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns JE into EJ, and 'différent' rearranges CEST into ECTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Exiles as a verb means banishes or throws out, as ejects does.

clue.text: Port with good taste in the past

parts.note: chic means stylishness, good taste
ago means in the past

explanation.surface: A harbour town that used to be stylish.
explanation.definitionFit: This city on Lake Michigan is a major inland port of the United States.

clue.text: Purchased some wood, a ton

parts.note: a bough is a branch, a piece of wood from a tree
T is the abbreviation for a ton

explanation.surface: Someone bought a tonne of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Purchased and bought are both past forms meaning acquired for money.

clue.text: Hostelry — one given new name

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A hotel is given a fresh title.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub or small hotel offering lodging is a traditional hostelry.

clue.text: To cock up is disastrous, affording protection for insects

indicators.note: something disastrous is a mess, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Botching things is a catastrophe, but it shelters bugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is disastrous' rearranges TO COCK UP; the definition is descriptive, the froth that shields froghopper nymphs.
explanation.definitionFit: The frothy foam seen on plants is secreted by froghopper larvae to shelter themselves from predators.

clue.text: Suitable assembly

definitions.meaning: old-fashioned word for fitting or proper
a gathering, as of riders for a hunt or athletes for a sports event

explanation.definitionFit: The word is an archaic adjective for proper and a noun for a gathering such as a hunt or athletics event.

clue.text: Cause strong reaction, in manner of speaking

indicators.note: from 'in a manner of speaking', telling us the phrase is said aloud

parts.note: 'in a sense' means in a manner, in a way

explanation.surface: Words can provoke strong feelings, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a manner of speaking' means 'in a sense'; spoken, IN SENSE sounds like the word for enrage.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrage someone is to provoke a strong angry response in them.

clue.text: Face of dour expert

parts.note: grim means stern, dour
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: The face of a sour specialist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Face' looks like a noun but is the twisted facial expression.
explanation.definitionFit: A grimace is a contorted facial expression, in the sense of pulling a face.

clue.text: Cattle not mixed with anything else

definitions.meaning: an old word for oxen or cattle, as in neatsfoot oil
undiluted, said of a drink served without water or ice

explanation.definitionFit: The word is an archaic term for bovine animals and also describes a spirit served undiluted.

clue.text: To be fired? Ghetto to be redeveloped

indicators.note: redeveloped areas are rebuilt, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A slum district faces regeneration.
explanation.definitionFit: To be dismissed from a job is to be kicked out, sacked.
